news.title: CrazyRun.io official soft launch initiates world-wide
news.article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms has launched CrazyRun.io, a free-to-play 3D multiplayer running game. Players take on the role of a runner, navigate through obstacles and compete against other players in a race to the finish line. The game offers a variety of levels and characters to unlock, adding an extra layer of replayability. The multiplayer mode allows players to compete against each other in real-time races. CrazyRun.io is now available to play for free in web browsers.
